```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Text'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<!-- Comprehensive comment covering all rare constructs -->
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <sub:child id="c1">
    <?target data="processing instruction content"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &internal;, and comments <!-- inner comment -->
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Value 1">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Value 2">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY extfile SYSTEM "external.txt" NDATA txt>
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
]>
<database xmlns="http://example.org/db" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Top comment block -->
  <record xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <?db-info cache="true" timeout="30"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Special characters check: <>&"' and markup: <record>nested</record>
    ]]>
    &ent2;
  </record>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY publisher "O'Reilly Media">
  <?catalog-meta version="2.0"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="urn:books" xmlns:m="urn:metadata">
  <!-- Metadata comment block -->
  <m:info>
    <?m:action type="refresh"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Publisher: &publisher;
    ]]>
  </m:info>
  <book>&publisher;</book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE system [
  <!ELEMENT system (node*)>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Core System">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; Extension">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <?sys-config debug="off"?>
]>
<!-- System Configuration File -->
<system xmlns="http://sys.org/ns" xmlns:cfg="http://sys.org/ns/config">
  <cfg:setting name="mode">
    <?cfg-target action="validate"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Config parameters: &derived;
    ]]>
  </cfg:setting>
  <node>&derived;</node>
</system>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY eA "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY eB "&eA; Beta">
  <!ENTITY eC "&eB; Gamma">
  <?doc-info author="Tester"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:p="http://doc.org/ns/presentation">
  <!-- Section comment -->
  <p:section id="s1">
    <?p:layout type="grid"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Hierarchical Entity test: &eC;
    ]]>
  </p:section>
  <section>&eC;</section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY local-ent 'Local Definition'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION zip SYSTEM "application/zip">
  <!ENTITY backup SYSTEM "data.zip" NDATA zip>
  <?archive-meta creator="AFL"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/ns/meta">
  <!-- Archive description comment -->
  <meta:details>
    <?meta-exec status="active"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Backup entity reference: &local-ent;
    ]]>
  </meta:details>
  <item>&local-ent;</item>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock*)>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY item1 "Widget">
  <!ENTITY item2 "&item1; Deluxe">
  <?inv-info location="Warehouse A"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inv.org/ns" xmlns:store="http://inv.org/ns/store">
  <!-- Warehouse stock comment -->
  <store:location id="wh1">
    <?store-op action="audit"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Stock items: &item2;
    ]]>
  </store:location>
  <stock>&item2;</stock>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE registry [
  <!ELEMENT registry (entry*)>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY val1 "Registry Value">
  <!ENTITY val2 "&val1; v2.0">
  <!NOTATION bin SYSTEM "application/octet-stream">
  <!ENTITY binfile SYSTEM "data.bin" NDATA bin>
  <?reg-init mode="secure"?>
]>
<registry xmlns="http://reg.org/ns" xmlns:admin="http://reg.org/ns/admin">
  <!-- Registry configuration comment -->
  <admin:settings>
    <?admin-action reload="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Registry entry content: &val2;
    ]]>
  </admin:settings>
  <entry>&val2;</entry>
</registry>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE portal [
  <!ELEMENT portal (page*)>
  <!ELEMENT page (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY title "Main Portal">
  <!ENTITY subtitle "&title; - Dashboard">
  <?portal-meta refresh="60"?>
]>
<portal xmlns="http://portal.org/ns" xmlns:ui="http://portal.org/ns/ui">
  <!-- Portal layout comment -->
  <ui:header>
    <?ui-directive render="full"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Welcome to &subtitle;
    ]]>
  </ui:header>
  <page>&subtitle;</page>
</portal>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE workspace [
  <!ELEMENT workspace (project*)>
  <!ELEMENT project (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ENTITY workspace-name 'Enterprise Workspace'>">
  %ext-macro;
  <!NOTATION ps SYSTEM "application/postscript">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "doc.ps" NDATA ps>
  <?workspace-init state="ready"?>
]>
<workspace xmlns="http://ws.org/ns" xmlns:team="http://ws.org/ns/team">
  <!-- Workspace overview comment -->
  <team:info>
    <?team-action sync="always"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Workspace name: &workspace-name;
    ]]>
  </team:info>
  <project>&workspace-name;</project>
</workspace>
